summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its buyout of the remaining 45% stake in Four 20 Pharma GmbH, a licensed German medical cannabis producer and distributor. Terms such as price per share, total implied value, and premium were not disclosed. The acquisition makes Four 20 Pharma a fully integrated subsidiary, strengthening Curaleaf's vertical supply chain from cultivation in Portugal and Canada to German distribution. The board recommended the transaction, advisors not named. Structural notes: the initial agreement was in 2022; no regulatory clock or break fee mentioned. What to watch: Curaleaf's international expansion into UK and Poland under the Four 20 brand.
